_comment: What the events of a journey without a patient graph say (timeline.json of the synthetic journeys; Documentation/design/graph-normalization.md#ranking). Event types: `plans` decide the therapies they name (tumor board), `gives` give them; in other events a named therapy is history or context. `parameters`: a parameter key gives `concepts` when present, `values` per value, or makes a diagnosis asserted or suspected (`implies`), also only from a number up (`atLeast`) and only in some event types (`events`). A disease profile adds the parameters of its disease (data/profiles).
